title: Uganda Climate Intelligence Framework (UCIF)
description: Reproducible pipeline and manuscript behind "A National Climate Anomaly Intelligence System for Uganda: Ground-Truth Validation, Risk Nowcasting, and Long-Term Climate Change Assessment". The framework builds a ground-truth-honest benchmark of unsupervised anomaly detectors against a curated disaster register, adds century-scale in-situ trends, an independent NASA POWER gap-fill of the 1990–2007 observing collapse, derived SPI/SPEI drought indices, a cereal-yield impact linkage, the UCASI severity index and SHAP-based explainability. Version 1.1 adds four forward-looking operational layers: drought early warning (SPI-6 trajectory and decline-run rules), yield impact forecast (growing-season SPI-3 regression), seasonal climate outlook (SEAS5 ensemble downscaled via Open-Meteo), and automated climate risk bulletin. Every reported number is computed by the pipeline; the manuscript cross-checks all claims against persisted artifacts.
